scope: Offline independent visual inspection of all 18 refreshed backup and all 8 refreshed search screenshots
revision: Observed HEAD 8e7c6b0e2352c388b59aa4b593110445469a0c49; dirty concurrently edited checkout, not immutable native acceptance
environment: Linux; browser fixture screenshots supplied by workflow; no native or browser execution by reviewer in this retest

findings.actual: Values now exposed and wrapping succeeds, but dark summary is visibly too low contrast. Light capture passes visual inspection.
All 18 captures consistently display 2.5 KiB (2,525 bytes).

pixel_sample_note: Most frequent RGB colors from screenshot summary region only; not DOM computed colors or a complete WCAG audit.
